lines.trans: Here is your station pickup sign, gentlemen: Welcome back to Room Eight and Room Nine!
Look, big brother—Qing even drew that exact eight-point compass rose in the corner!
The train pulls into platform three in twenty minutes, little brother, and walking to the station takes twelve.
With so many people in a big university lecture hall ten years ago, will he even remember me?
Are you kidding, Hao? You spotted his tiny ink star in under a second!
Besides, teachers never forget the quiet student who measured every single room in his notebook.

examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kè zhàn. Measure word (量词): 家 (jiā), e.g. 一家客栈 ('an inn').

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

examples.text: 我们客栈都是五星级服务……哎呀！
examples.trans: At our inn, everything is five-star service... whoops!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo. Everyday adjective for small size; also prefixes younger colleagues' names warmly (小晴, 小美).

examples.text: 早上好，姑娘。我有一个宋名下的预订。
examples.trans: Good morning, young lady. I have a booking for Song.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo tí qín. Combines 小 ('small') + 提 ('hold/carry in hand') + 琴 ('stringed instrument'); measure word: 把 (bǎ).

examples.text: 三十年前，每个星期五傍晚他都带着一把小提琴来九号房。
examples.trans: Thirty years ago, every Friday evening he brought a violin to Room Nine.

examples.text: 老先生答应星期五带上小提琴，和宋老师的钢琴一起合奏。
examples.trans: The elderly gentleman promised to bring his violin on Friday and play a duet with Teacher Song's piano.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo qíng. Friendly name of Courtyard Inn's new receptionist.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Highlights immediacy, exact location (就在这里), or smooth consequence ('then').

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǐ jīng. Often pairs with sentence-final 了 (已经到了 'has already arrived').

examples.text: 没错！你已经很习惯这儿了。
examples.trans: Exactly! You already fit right in here.

examples.text: 还好烤箱里的面团已经放进去了。
examples.trans: My dough is already in the oven, at least.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàng zi. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条巷子 ('a lane').

examples.text: 走花摊旁边第二条路，别进窄巷子。
examples.trans: Take the second lane beside the flower stall; do not enter the narrow alley.

examples.text: 梧桐巷是一条种满老树的安静巷子。
examples.trans: Wutong Lane is a quiet alley lined with old trees.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bāng. Everyday verb for helping someone (帮我一下 'give me a hand').

examples.text: 我来帮您。哎呀，里面装了石头吗？
examples.trans: Let me help you. Goodness, did you pack stones inside?

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nián. Time classifier taking no 个 directly after numbers (六年 'six years', 今年 'this year').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi. Versatile verb for opening doors, starting business, turning on taps/lights, or water boiling.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

meanings.en: younger brother (affectionate short form of 弟弟)
meanings.note: Pinyin: dì. Often used in direct address ('弟') or with 我弟 ('my younger brother') in warm sibling speech.

examples.text: 两点二十八分！我跟我弟现在就得去中央车站啦！
examples.trans: Twenty-eight past two! My little brother and I need to head for Central Station right now!

examples.text: 志鹏拍拍我弟的肩膀，说好一起抬起沉甸甸的木隔条。
examples.trans: Peng patted his younger brother on the shoulder as they lifted the wooden spacer bars together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Read de after a verb to introduce how it goes (走得快 'walk fast'); read děi before a verb to mean 'must'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhì háo. Given name of Zhipeng's older brother, an acoustic architect.

examples.text: 没关系！您就是志豪先生吧？
examples.trans: No problem at all! You must be Mr Zhihao, right?

examples.text: 是的，我叫志豪。昨天打电话订了七号房。
examples.trans: Yes, my name is Zhihao. Yesterday I booked room seven by phone.

meanings.note: Failing to remember someone or something.

examples.text: 我忙得差点忘记了今天是周五。
examples.trans: I got so busy I nearly forgot today is Friday.

examples.text: 她从来不会忘记朋友的生日。
examples.trans: She never forgets a friend's birthday.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài. As an adjective/adverb, 'fast/quickly'; in 快…了, 'about to'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 小晴，快看里面！这不是我的箱子！
examples.trans: Qing, look inside quickly! This is not my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ men. First-person plural pronoun; add 的 for 'our' (我们的).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间房 ('a room').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng jiān. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间房间 ('a room').

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 放心吧，周经理。房间干净，毛巾也是新的。
examples.trans: Relax, Manager Zhou. The room is clean, and the towels are fresh.

meanings.en: hit; make (a call); give (a score); fetch
meanings.note: Pinyin: dǎ. Light verb forming dozens of everyday expressions (打电话 'make a phone call').

examples.text: 小晴，马上给火车站失物处打电话。
examples.trans: Qing, call the train station lost-and-found office right away.

examples.text: 我正在打……您好，请问有人找蓝色行李箱吗？
examples.trans: I am calling now... Hello, excuse me, is anyone looking for a blue suitcase?

meanings.en: measure word for handled objects; disposal marker
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎ. Counts items with handles or backs (一把钥匙, 一把椅子); as a preposition, fronts a definite object before an action verb.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

拎.gloss: to carry by a handle or strap

meanings.en: to lift and carry something dangling from one's hand (bag, basket, hatbox)
meanings.note: Pinyin: līn. Everyday verb contrasting with 抱 (hug in arms), 扛 (hoist on shoulder), and 捧 (cradle in both hands).

examples.text: 对呀，特别礼貌的两位徒步客——还有位拎花纹帽盒的文静女士订了六号房！
examples.trans: Yes, such polite hikers—and a quiet lady carrying a floral hatbox booked Room Six!

examples.text: 难不成徒步客把双肩包拎去六号房，而帽盒去了二号房？！
examples.trans: Don't tell me the hikers hauled their backpacks to Room Six while the hatbox went to Room Two?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: ná. Core verb for holding or fetching objects in the hand.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

examples.text: 火车站有人拿错了我的蓝色行李箱！
examples.trans: Someone at the train station took my blue suitcase by mistake!

related.gloss: handle with care (lift gently, set down gently)

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē. Used for answering calls (接电话), meeting someone at a station, or catching drips.

examples.text: 完了！昨天我没戴眼镜，在平板上接了电话预订！
examples.trans: Disaster! Yesterday without my glasses I took a phone booking on the tablet!

examples.text: 志豪接干毛巾的时候随手放下的！
examples.trans: Hao set it down casually when he took the dry towel!

meanings.en: to shake back and forth; ring a hanging or hand bell
meanings.note: Pinyin: yáo. Used for ringing gate bells (摇门铃), shaking bottles, or trees swaying.

examples.text: 三点出租车一到门口，记得把门铃摇两下！
examples.trans: As soon as your taxi pulls up at three, remember to ring the gate bell twice!

examples.text: 有人把黄铜门铃摇了两下——那是兄弟俩的暗号！
examples.trans: Someone just rang the brass gate bell twice—that is the signal from the brothers!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiào shì. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān). Combines 教 (teach) with 室 (room).

examples.text: 十年前大学大教室那么多人，老师还认得清我吗？
examples.trans: With so many people in a big university lecture hall ten years ago, will he even remember me?

examples.text: 志豪回忆说，老教授当年在教室黑板上画的地图总是又快又准。
examples.trans: Hao recalled that the maps the old professor drew on the classroom chalkboard were always fast and exact.

meanings.note: Pinyin: páng biān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 旁边位置 ('a spot beside').

examples.text: 旁边的把手上系着一张小纸牌。
examples.trans: There is a small paper card tied on the side handle.

examples.text: 看拉链旁边……对，有她的名字缩写！
examples.trans: Check beside the zipper... yes, her name initials are here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng. Measure word (量词): 颗 (kē), e.g. 一颗星 ('a star').

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

examples.text: 晴朗的夜空能看见很多星。
examples.trans: On a clear night sky you can see many stars.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cháo. Describes which way a window faces or waving toward someone (朝院子 'facing the courtyard').

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Potential phrase láidejí ('still in time to do something').

examples.text: 那份合同我还没有来得及看。
examples.trans: I have not had time to read that contract yet.

examples.text: 现在出发去演播厅还来得及。
examples.trans: Leaving for the studio now will still get us there in time.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wú tóng xiàng. Tree-lined lane in Chengdu where Courtyard Inn stands.

examples.text: 等一下……梧桐巷十二号，角落里还写着两个童年名字的首字母！
examples.trans: Wait a moment... Number twelve, Wutong Lane, with two childhood initials written in the corner!

examples.text: 宋老师，您一脸惊讶！您认识梧桐巷十二号吗？
examples.trans: Teacher Song, you look amazed! Do you know Number twelve, Wutong Lane?

meanings.note: Pinyin: huān yíng. Warm greeting to arriving guests (欢迎！ / 欢迎光临！).

examples.text: 大家早上好！欢迎你，小晴。都准备好了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning, everyone! Welcome, Qing. Is everything ready?

examples.text: 欢迎光临！早上好，您好！
examples.trans: Welcome! Good morning, hello!

meanings.en: right in the middle of; squarely; right
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng. Before a verb, marks an action in progress right now; before 对着, means 'directly/squarely'.

examples.text: 正合我心意。楼梯在哪儿？
examples.trans: Just what I wanted. Where are the stairs?

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 外卡？每个导师确实有个外卡名额，但是你之前已经放弃了。
examples.trans: A wild card? Every mentor does get one wild-card spot, except you already waived yours earlier.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Adverb yǒngyuǎn ('forever / always').

examples.text: 总编室永远不招实习生。
examples.trans: The chief editor's office never takes interns.

examples.text: 我永远支持你。
examples.trans: I will support you forever.

meanings.en: along; following the course of a road, river, or edge
meanings.note: Pinyin: yán. Often followed by 着 (zhe) to form 沿着 ('following along').

examples.text: 今天绝对不钻周经理那些小巷子——沿着梧桐巷直奔中央车站！
examples.trans: Definitely no diving into Zhou's little side alleys today—straight down Wutong Lane to Central Station!

examples.text: 两位客人沿着青石板小路慢慢走，一边走一边看灯笼。
examples.trans: The two guests walked slowly along the flagstone path, admiring the lanterns as they went.

meanings.note: In 全清, means background/account checks came back 100% clean.

examples.text: 所有嘉宾的背景核查都已经是全清状态。
examples.trans: Background checks on every guest came back completely clean.

examples.text: 清晨的空气格外清，让人精神一振。
examples.trans: Morning air is extra clear and refreshing.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huǒ chē. Measure word (量词): 列 (liè), e.g. 一列火车 ('a train').

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: diǎn. Marks hours on the clock (八点 'eight o'clock') or 'a bit' (一点).

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

meanings.note: Used literally for cards or figuratively for leverage.

examples.text: 这是我们谈判手里最后一张牌了。
examples.trans: This is the very last card in our hand for the talks.

examples.text: 把好牌打好，才能赢得最后的胜利。
examples.trans: Only by playing good cards well can you win in the end.

examples.text: 王总，开什么玩笑呢？
examples.trans: Director Wang, what kind of joke is this?

examples.text: 王总，开什么玩笑呢？
examples.trans: Director Wang, what kind of joke is this?

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàn zài. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 现在这时候 ('this moment right now').

examples.text: 现在他的箱子还安全锁着呢。
examples.trans: For now, his suitcase stays safely locked up.

examples.text: 太好了！现在我想吃一顿丰盛的早餐。
examples.trans: Wonderful! Now I would like to eat a big breakfast.

related.gloss: this moment right now (measure word 个)

meanings.note: Pinyin: huà. Used for drawing blueprints or painting signs.

examples.text: 上面怎么用铅笔整齐画了这条街三家客栈？
examples.trans: Why are three inns on this street neatly sketched in pencil on it?

examples.text: 门上方只画着一把金色钥匙。拿旧阀门给店员看。
examples.trans: Only a golden key painted above the door. Show the clerk the old valve.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liú. Used for leaving a note/keepsake, saving food, or staying on (留下来).

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 为什么把鞋和木头小火车留到星期五呢？
examples.trans: Why leave the shoes and little wooden train here until Friday?

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.en: to head straight toward; make a beeline for
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhí bēn. Note the falling tone on bēn ('dash straight toward'), distinct from bèn ('rush blindly').

examples.text: 它飘过第四桌，往左一拐，直奔院子里的石水盆去了！
examples.trans: It's gliding past table four, banking left, and heading straight for the courtyard stone basin!

examples.text: 兄弟俩一出客栈大门就直奔车站，一步都没敢耽搁。
examples.trans: The moment the two brothers stepped out of the inn gate, they headed straight for the station without pausing.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhí jiē. Describes doing something directly without detours.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 您为什么不直接去志鹏家门口把木头小火车交给他呢？
examples.trans: Why not go straight to Zhipeng's door and hand him the wooden train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn. Covers looking at something, reading silently, or visiting someone; add 见/到 for 'catch sight of'.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǎn jing. Measure word (量词): 双 (shuāng), e.g. 一双眼睛 ('a pair of eyes').

examples.text: 天哪……看这双眼睛！第三级台阶上的小志豪？！
examples.trans: Good heavens... look at those eyes! Little Zhihao from the third step?!

examples.text: 咬一口……志豪，闭上眼睛！跟爷爷的蛋糕味道一模一样！
examples.trans: One bite... Zhihao, close your eyes! That tastes exactly like Grandfather's cake!

related.gloss: a pair of eyes (measure word 双)

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhe. Placed right after a verb to show a state or posture continues (门开着 'the door stands open').

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: miǎo zhōng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 几秒钟 ('a few seconds').

examples.text: 志鹏不会走的。他总是嘴硬五秒钟，心马上就软了。
examples.trans: Zhipeng will not leave. He always talked tough for five seconds, then softened right away.

examples.text: 明信片上整齐的方格字，我两秒钟就认出来了。
examples.trans: That neat block handwriting on the postcard—I recognized it in two seconds.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhàn. As a verb, 'stand' (站在旁边); as a noun, 'station/stop' (火车站).

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

examples.text: 听得很清楚。你站在小石头喷泉旁边吗？
examples.trans: Loud and clear. Are you standing beside the little stone fountain?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhàn tái. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个站台 ('a station platform').

examples.text: 热汤？在冷雨中走过来之后，这听起来太棒了。
examples.trans: Hot soup? After that cold walk in the rain, that sounds wonderful.

examples.text: 谁能想到，星期一早上志豪在二站台拿错了蓝箱子。
examples.trans: Who would have thought that on Monday morning Hao grabbed the wrong blue bag on Platform Two.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǐ jì běn. Measure word (量词): 本 (běn), e.g. 一本笔记本 ('a notebook').

examples.text: 等等——柜台上这本棕色小皮笔记本是谁的？
examples.trans: Wait—whose small brown leather notebook is this on the counter?

examples.text: 啊，我的皮笔记本！谢谢！我正到处找呢。
examples.trans: Oh, my leather notebook! Thank you! I was looking everywhere for it.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dā ying. Means agreeing to a request or giving one's word.

examples.text: 让我猜猜，你把没有的房间答应给别人了？
examples.trans: Let me guess: you promised someone a room we do not have?

examples.text: 既然答应了别人，就一定要准时做到。
examples.trans: Once you give someone your word, be sure to follow through on time.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuē. Used for arranging a meeting time or meal.

examples.text: 约他星期五中午在这儿见面吗？
examples.trans: Asking him to meet you here on Friday at noon?

examples.text: 我约了老朋友明天中午喝茶。
examples.trans: I arranged to meet an old friend for tea tomorrow at noon.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gěi. As main verb, 'give'; as preposition/complement, marks the recipient (给你 'for/to you', 递给我 'pass to me').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jué duì. Strong emphatic adverb.

examples.text: 而且大哥想装作镇定的时候，绝对不会早到。
examples.trans: Besides, when older brothers want to act calm, they never arrive early.

examples.text: 用咸黄油炒出来的鸡蛋绝对香！
examples.trans: Scrambled eggs made with salted butter are guaranteed to smell amazing!

meanings.note: Pinyin: luó pán. Measure word (量词): 面 (miàn) or 个 (gè). Joins 罗 ('net, to gather') + 盘 ('plate, tray').

examples.text: 抽屉深处藏着一面古董航海罗盘。
examples.trans: Hidden deep in the drawer is an antique nautical compass.

examples.text: 制图员教授当年就是用这面罗盘在山里测绘的。
examples.trans: The mapmaker professor used this very compass to survey in the mountains back in the day.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo shī. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位老师 ('a teacher').

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 宋老师，怎么了？您按了门铃！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, what happened? You rang the bell!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xíng li xiāng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个行李箱 ('a suitcase').

examples.text: 很安静，谢谢，不过这个行李箱今天特别重。
examples.trans: Very quiet, thank you, though this suitcase feels especially heavy today.

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.en: want; need; will / be going to
meanings.note: Pinyin: yào. Direct verb for ordering/requesting ('want'), obligation ('need to'), or imminent future (要下雨了).

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎo luò. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个角落 ('a corner').

examples.text: 当心那把角落椅子，等十秒我拧紧螺丝。
examples.trans: Mind that corner chair—wait ten seconds while I tighten the screw.

examples.text: 为小院客栈干杯——成都最热闹的安静角落！
examples.trans: Cheers to Courtyard Inn—the liveliest quiet corner in Chengdu!

meanings.note: Pinyin: rèn. Core verb in 认识 ('know'), 认出来 ('recognize'), and 认输 ('admit defeat').

examples.text: 留下来，小美。就算他转身走出大门，我也认了。
examples.trans: I am staying, Mei. Even if he turns around and walks straight out the gate.

examples.text: 明信片上整齐的方格字，我两秒钟就认出来了。
examples.trans: That neat block handwriting on the postcard—I recognized it in two seconds.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rèn de. Joins 认 ('to recognize') + 得 (complement particle). Usually used for recognizing people or familiar objects.

examples.text: 志鹏一眼就认得这是弟弟小时候的字迹。
examples.trans: At a glance, Peng recognized this as his younger brother's childhood handwriting.

examples.text: 小晴刚来客栈没多久，还不认得所有的常客。
examples.trans: Qing hasn't been at the inn for long, and still doesn't recognize all the regular guests.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jì de. Describes recalling something from memory.

examples.text: 钱箱里拿五十块，记得要收据！
examples.trans: Here is fifty yuan from the cash box; remember to get a receipt!

examples.text: 这么多年过去了，您还记得？
examples.trans: After all these years, you still remember that?

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiáo yīn. Separable verb-object compound 调 (tiáo, 2nd tone 'adjust/harmonize') + 音 ('pitch/tone').

examples.text: 等老陈修好那根琴槌，宋老师就能给钢琴调音了。
examples.trans: Once Chen fixes that piano hammer, Teacher Song will be able to tune the piano.

examples.text: 音乐会开始前，调音师花了一个小时给钢琴仔细调音。
examples.trans: Before the concert began, the technician spent an hour carefully tuning the piano.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǒu. Means 'walk' (走路, 直走) or 'leave / head off' (我先走了).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chē zhàn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个车站 ('a station').

examples.text: 啊……下这么大的雨，车站附近酒店全满了。
examples.trans: Ah... in rain this heavy, every hotel near the station was full.

examples.text: 雨天打车难，我们早点去车站吧。
examples.trans: Hailing a cab in the rain takes longer, so let's head to the station early.

related.gloss: be stuck in a traffic jam

meanings.note: Pinyin: liàng. Counts cars, taxis, buses, and bicycles (一辆出租车 'a taxi').

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

examples.text: 你们听一秒……街上一辆汽车的声音都听不到。
examples.trans: Listen for a second... you cannot hear a single car from the street.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guò lái. Directional compound moving across toward the speaker.

examples.text: 你看，早餐忙乱和神秘电话你都挺过来了！
examples.trans: Look, you made it through both the breakfast rush and the mystery phone call!

examples.text: 因为星期一晚上我走过来时，看见我哥哥正走在这条街上！
examples.trans: Because when I walked here Monday night, I saw my older brother walking down this street!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jìn. Stative adjective ('near') and resultative complement after verbs (照近一点 'shine closer').

examples.text: 请把台灯照近一点，好让我看清楚里面的小零件。
examples.trans: Please shine the lamp a little closer so I can see the tiny parts inside clearly.

examples.text: 小院客栈离星期六的蔬菜集市非常近。
examples.trans: Courtyard Inn is very close to the Saturday vegetable market.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hái. Everyday adverb meaning 'still' (还在), 'not yet' (还没), or 'even more' after 比.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

examples.text: 宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, I am truly sorry; they have no news over there yet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lián. Pairs with 都/也 to highlight 'even X' (连名字都一样), or means 'connect' as a verb.

examples.text: 老房子连着旧回忆——那种争吵最伤人。
examples.trans: Old houses are tied to old memories—arguments like that cut deepest.

examples.text: 笔挺又干净，周经理！连眼镜都戴在鼻子上，没在额头上。
examples.trans: Crisp and spotless, Manager Zhou! Even your glasses are on your nose instead of your forehead.

遍.gloss: time (once through, from start to finish)

meanings.en: time (once through, from start to finish)
meanings.note: Pinyin: biàn. Counts complete run-throughs of an action (再算一遍 'count it through once more'); compare 次 for simple occurrences.

examples.text: 等等……让我再算一遍。整个房间只要这么一点钱？
examples.trans: Wait... let me add it up again. The whole room needs only this much money?

examples.text: 请您再说一遍，好吗？
examples.trans: Could you say that once more, please?

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào. Appears in split verb-object phrases like 道个歉 ('offer an apology').

examples.text: 先生，上楼之前，我要诚恳跟您道个歉。
examples.trans: Sir, before going upstairs, I owe you an honest apology.

examples.text: 临走的时候，他特意来道谢。
examples.trans: Before leaving, he came specially to say thank you.

related.gloss: know (a fact or piece of information)

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà. Distal demonstrative before measure words (那个 'that one'); at clause start, means 'then / well then'.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

examples.text: 最想搞掉的就是那个淳于乔。
examples.trans: The one you want to take down most is that Chun Yuqiao.

examples.text: 靠墙的那个深蓝色皮箱是昨天傍晚刚寄到的。
examples.trans: That dark blue leather suitcase against the wall just arrived yesterday evening.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà me. Opens a conclusion drawn from what was just said (那么，门在哪儿？ 'So where is the door?'); before an adjective it means 'that (much)'.

examples.text: 那么，那些旧书后面有第九扇门！
examples.trans: So behind those old books, there's a ninth door!

examples.text: 那么小美的咖啡馆和宋老师的钢琴，不会吵醒楼上的客人吧？
examples.trans: So Mei's café and Teacher Song's piano won't wake the guests upstairs?

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà xiē. Plural of 那个 ('those').

examples.text: 老陈，抱起那些纸箱，我们下楼吧！
examples.trans: Chen, pick up those cardboard boxes—down the stairs we go!

examples.text: 抬头看夜空下那些金色灯笼——真宁静啊！
examples.trans: Look up at those golden lanterns against the night sky—how peaceful!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lín jū. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位邻居 ('a neighbor').

examples.text: 超过八十年的小院建筑，只要一楼每天服务街坊邻居，禁止改成私人办公室。
examples.trans: Any courtyard building over eighty years old may not become private offices as long as the ground floor serves neighbours daily.

examples.text: 每天服务街坊邻居——就像对公众开放的早间咖啡馆？！
examples.trans: Serves neighbours daily—like a morning café open to the public?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōu. Summarizes everything BEFORE it and always stands directly before the verb/adjective (我们都喜欢).

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 里面 ('the inside').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

meanings.note: Pinyin: liáng. Note 2nd-tone reading liáng for the verb 'measure' (contrasting with 4th-tone noun 数量 shù liàng 'quantity').

examples.text: 志豪已经用尺子量过九号房的平面图了，里面刚好摆四张方木桌。
examples.trans: Hao has already measured Room Nine's floor plan with a ruler—four square wooden tables fit inside just right.

examples.text: 做烘焙讲究精确，小美总是仔细量好每一勺面粉和白糖。
examples.trans: Baking requires precision, so Mei always carefully measures every spoonful of flour and sugar.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāng qín. Measure word (量词): 架 (jià), e.g. 一架钢琴 ('a piano').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 何止认识！整整六年，每个星期五我都爬那座木楼梯教钢琴！
examples.trans: More than know it! Every Friday for six whole years I climbed those wooden stairs to teach piano!

examples.text: 王尔实在是太狡猾了，他趁着我们去年系统升级的时候钻了这个空子。
examples.trans: Wang Er was remarkably cunning; he exploited a gap during our internal system upgrade last autumn.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mén kǒu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 大门口 ('at the doorway').

examples.text: 等等——那星期一晚上门口台阶……第二个蓝箱子……
examples.trans: Wait—then Monday night on our front step... the second blue suitcase...

examples.text: 您为什么不直接去志鹏家门口把木头小火车交给他呢？
examples.trans: Why not go straight to Zhipeng's door and hand him the wooden train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: mén líng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个门铃 ('a doorbell').

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuàn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个院子 ('a courtyard').

examples.text: 有，结实的木床、干净书桌，风景全院最好。
examples.trans: Yes, a solid wooden bed, a clean desk, and the best view in the courtyard.

examples.text: 前院种着花草，后院十分安静。
examples.trans: Flowers grow in the front yard, and the back courtyard is quiet.

meanings.en: lean against; be next to; rely on
meanings.note: Pinyin: kào. Describes sitting by the window (靠窗) or relying on luck (全靠运气).

examples.text: 全靠运气——加上星期一早上火车上拿错的蓝色行李箱！
examples.trans: Pure luck—plus one swapped blue suitcase on Monday morning's train!

examples.text: 她喜欢坐在靠窗的安静位置。
examples.trans: She likes sitting in the quiet spot by the window.
